summary.plain: The international team of physicists, based at CERN and Gran Sasso, who built and ran the OPERA tau-neutrino detector from 2008 to 2012.
summary.technical: Collaboration (140+ authors on its 2015 discovery paper) that built and operated the OPERA emulsion detector at LNGS Hall C on the CERN-to-Gran-Sasso (CNGS) neutrino beam from 2008 to 2012, reporting discovery of νμ → ντ appearance at 5.1σ.
